content:
The map is unchanged — no tilled soil, notice board still there. So the numeric interact calls silently did nothing (or the small brain didn't report them). The real problem: I don't know the valid button ids. 

Let me reconsider. The interact primitive says "presses the button" — maybe the valid values are specific names. Let me try common ones: "primary", "secondary", "action", "a", "x". But rather than guess blindly, note that the small brain reports "unknown-input: X" for bad ones — so I can probe several in one plan and see which don't error.

args.approach: Numeric buttons did nothing and string names error as unknown-input; probe a batch of candidate button names (primary, secondary, action, a, x, confirm, interact) on the notice board to discover the valid id, then use the winner for tilling/planting/watering.
